oil.when: 2019 with the service reminder in the multi-information display (colour or single-colour screen)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have been changed or the scheduled service was done.
Leave the ignition (operation mode) OFF. The reminder cannot be cleared with the ignition ON.
Tap the multi-information display switch on the instrument cluster a few times until the service reminder screen with the wrench symbol appears.
Press and hold the same switch for about 2 seconds until the wrench symbol starts to flash.
While it is flashing, tap the switch once. The dashes change to CLEAR and the time and distance to the next service are shown.
If you wait about 10 seconds without pressing anything, the screen backs out and you need to start again.
oil.note: Checked against the maker's 2019 Outlander owner's manual (UK edition of the same generation). Other years of this generation likely work the same way, but that was not confirmed.

tpms.when: 2008–2013 (sensor in each wheel, no driver reset)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the driver's door jamb sticker, and check the spare too.
Drive normally. There is no reset button: the light goes out by itself once the system reads the correct pressures.
If the light is still on after about 10 minutes of driving, recheck the pressures and look for a slow leak or puncture.
tpms.note: A flashing light means a wheel without a working sensor is fitted or the system has a fault; a reset will not clear it. New or replaced sensors have to be registered by a shop with a scan tool.

notes: When service is due the display shows dashes in place of the time and distance left, and a message appears for a few seconds at start-up.
